voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Eilean Mòr, in the Outer Hebrides. December, nineteen hundred. A passing ship saw that the island's lighthouse was dark.
Weather held off the relief boat until Boxing Day. When it landed, the three keepers were gone.
The lamps were cleaned and ready. The clock had stopped. One set of oilskins was still inside.
At the west landing, iron railings were twisted, and a block of stone weighing over a ton had been moved.
The inquiry believed a great wave had swept them away. No trace of the three men was ever found.
